name: Kadwr
text: Kadwr is a spelling of the name Cador. Cador is a ruler shown around King Arthur in the Welsh and Arthurian tale. The spelling with K changes the hard c of the Irish and Welsh ways of writing. Kadwr therefore keeps one form of an Arthurian name.

key_results: Give the common form of the name.
Set the name in the Arthurian tale.
